groups.title: Woodwind instruments
groups.explanation: These four make up the woodwind section of an orchestra.

groups.title: Brass instruments
groups.explanation: Each is played by buzzing the lips into a metal mouthpiece.

groups.title: Bowed strings
groups.explanation: All four are bowed and sit at the front of the orchestra.

sources.excerpt: Common examples include flute, clarinet, oboe, bassoon, and saxophone.
Trumpets, trombones, and tubas are characteristically fitted with a cupped mouthpiece, while horns are fitted with a conical mouthpiece.
It normally consists of first and second violins, violas, cellos, and double basses.
